ascension-island.title: Flag of Ascension Island
desc:
- The unofficial flag of Ascension Island is a Blue Ensign with the territory's coat of arms in the fly
- The arms feature two turtles and a mountain representing Green Mountain
- Ascension Island, a volcanic island in the South Atlantic, is a dependency of Saint Helena
- As it has no official flag, the Blue Ensign version is used for ceremonial purposes
- **Construction:** British Blue Ensign with coat of arms badge in the fly half. Ratio 1:2
trivia:
- Ascension Island is a remote British territory in the Atlantic Ocean
- The island has a tiny population of around 800 people
- Home to an important military base and BBC relay station
